# RSE-hackathon

Two days of building research software engineering tools in **Glasgow**.

[Register on Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/rse-hackathon-2026-at-university-of-glasgow-tickets-2000034040655){.cta target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.hero-body}
Research Software Engineering (RSE) practice and training remain fragmented along disciplinary lines:
each field reinvents tooling, conventions, and teaching material, so we will conduct an open hackathon to prototype discipline-overarching RSE frameworks
— shared, reusable building blocks that work across the social sciences,
life sciences, and the humanities rather than within a single silo.

In two days, the team will produce an overall system design (such as a UML diagram) and a working end-to-end prototype.
We will use a thin-slice approach: rather than spending time building a complete database or UI,
we will connect just enough of each layer to show a user interacting with a real, working feature.

Other ideas for projects and prototyping are of course more than welcome!

## Practical information
The hackathon takes place at [University of Glasgow, Scotland]{.highlight} on the 26th and 27th of November, 2026.

_Day 1:_ lightning talks framing the challenges, team formation, and prototyping

_Day 2:_ build a short showcase and a community roadmap for carrying winning prototypes forward.

Hybrid attendance for remote contributors is also possible.
:::

The coolest module gets an award and stiped.

<button id="theme-toggle" class="theme-toggle" aria-label="Toggle light and dark mode"></button>
<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle');
  var stored = localStorage.getItem('theme-v2');
  var systemDark = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;

  if (stored === 'dark') {
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
  } else if (stored === 'light') {
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
  }

  function isDarkNow() {
    var attr = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    if (attr === 'dark') return true;
    if (attr === 'light') return false;
    return systemDark;
  }

  function updateLabel() {
    btn.textContent = isDarkNow() ? '☀ Light mode' : '● Dark mode';
  }

  updateLabel();
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (isDarkNow()) {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      localStorage.setItem('theme-v2', 'light');
    } else {
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
      localStorage.setItem('theme-v2', 'dark');
    }
    updateLabel();
  });
})();
</script>
